description: Rappi restaurant menu and prices (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru, Uruguay, Ecuador, Costa Rica): for a Rappi store ID returns store name, brand, address, open status, ETA, delivery fee, rating and reviews, cuisine tags, weekly schedule, active offers, and the menu by section with each product's price, original price, discount %, availability and description. From the public restaurant page; no store search. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: mx (default), br, co, ar, cl, pe, uy, ec, cr; taken from the URL if a URL is given

maxProducts.description: Max menu products to return, 1 to 500 (default 200)

storeId.description: Rappi store ID (the number in rappi.<country>/restaurantes/<id>-name) or a restaurant URL (required)
